subject: Invoice recipient transfer + VAT registration evidence needed — Kestrel Dynamics
messages:
From: Oliver Barnes <obarnes@kestrel-dynamics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@kestrel-dynamics.com>, treasury@kestrel-dynamics.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to change invoice recipient + VAT certificate attached

Hi Stephanie —

Quick context: Kestrel closed a small acquisition last month and is consolidating several SaaS vendors onto a new UK-registered subsidiary (Kestrel Technologies Ltd) for EMEA billing. We need Redwood to start issuing invoices to the new legal entity and remit address effective July 1 for all subscriptions and committed capacity.

Can you confirm what you need from us to (1) update the billing address and legal name on invoices, and (2) apply the UK VAT registration to the account so we aren’t charged VAT at the wrong rate? I’ve attached our VAT registration certificate and a spreadsheet with the new wire details.

We also have one outstanding invoice (INV-2026-1589) dated Jun 10 that was billed to the old entity. Will Redwood be able to reissue that invoice to Kestrel Technologies Ltd or should we remit now and you credit/reissue afterwards?

Attaching: Kestrel_VAT_certificate.pdf, Kestrel_Treasury_Wire_Instructions.xlsx

Thanks — appreciate the help on timing. We’re trying to avoid late payments while the ledger moves over.

—Oliver
Oliver Barnes
Head of Finance Operations
Kestrel Dynamics

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Barnes <obarnes@kestrel-dynamics.com>, Natalie Ruiz <natalie.ruiz@kestrel-dynamics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to change invoice recipient + VAT certificate attached

Thanks for the details, Oliver — and welcome the update. I’ve reviewed the attachments briefly. Two immediate items from Redwood side:

1) We need a scanned copy of the VAT cert (you attached — good) and confirmation of the billing legal name exactly as you want it on the tax invoice ("Kestrel Technologies Ltd" — please confirm company number and registered address line exactly).

2) For the outstanding invoice INV-2026-1589 we can reissue under the new remit if you confirm the change applies retroactively to June invoices. Our collections team prefers issuing a credit on the old invoice and reissuing a new invoice to avoid double-pay complications. If Kestrel prefers to pay now, we will process a credit once the new invoice is issued.

Marcus — can you advise Treasury on whether we need a formal W-8/W-9 equivalent for UK entity handling? Also need a quick check on our system: will reissuing the invoice to the new legal entity affect the subscription meterings or usage allocation on our side?

Grace — please prepare a draft invoice (sample) with the new legal name and address (I’ve attached a short sample file). If we can sign off today we should get the reissued invoice before July 1.

Oliver — once you confirm the exact legal name and give the green light on retroactive reissue, we’ll proceed.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Stephanie —

From a Treasury/Finance standpoint:

- Reissue workflow: Standard approach is credit the original invoice and issue a new one to the new entity. That avoids double-pay edge cases on our end and keeps the audit trail clean.
- Tax handling: Since Kestrel provided a UK VAT registration certificate, we will mark the account VAT-exempt for B2B intra-UK/EU transactions where appropriate. Finance will need the VAT number and verification date (please confirm the registration number printed on the PDF).
- Wire/PO: Please confirm whether Kestrel wants payments routed to the new bank details moving forward starting with the next due invoice. If they pay INV-2026-1589 now to the old account, we will process the credit and reissue the new invoice; the credit will show as a separate line for reconciliation.

Attached is a proposed invoice sample (proposed-invoice-sample.pdf) with the new legal name and the registered address per Oliver’s note — Grace, can you validate the address formatting to meet HMRC requirements (company number on invoice, invoice VAT breakdown, and VAT number visible)?

Also Oliver — please confirm the company number and the exact registered address line for the invoice footer. If you’d like, we can run the VAT number through our verification tool and send a confirmation back.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
